evidence.observation: Smooth, stable column profile with slow upward drift; head T712 ~72 °C steady
Reboiler reads ~423 °C, physically implausible vs. rest of column — likely fixed scaling/offset artifact, constant throughout
Reflux ~0.11 L/h, distillate ~0.38 L/h, ratio ~4.5-5.5, noisy but stationary
Differential pressures ~0.5/2.0 mbar and system pressure ~495 mbar stable, no flooding or blockage
Single-sample dropout to 0 at k=19, recovered at k=20 — transient switch chatter, no corroborating process change

args.missing_evidence: A distillate/bottoms composition measurement (GC) to judge separation; independent check of T701 calibration and of the LS701 momentary low signal.
